'''Galactic Cultures - A Visitor's Guide to the Galaxy''' was a publication which gave a basic introduction and description of many of the diffirent cultures of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It contained a section on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] and an average [[Liann]] citizen detailing their close connections with [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] industry.
